acceptanceCriteria: an owner-accepted TCP amendment and an eval showing no regression on the frozen Corvint set and a gain on Beamfall tasks
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 panel review addendum (Beamfall fit and corvint-tasks), scratchpad review/out/panel-addendum.md. §5 disputed item 3 and §6 item 4. taskcontext.go:1516,1599 hardwires docs/specs/*.md and 3-digit IDs per TCP-V0-009, a de facto layout requirement in tension with invariant 6. Proposal: take spec roots from the adoption inventory SPECIFICATION class (245 files in Beamfall) or a declared list, default docs/specs; accept [A-Z]+(-[A-Z0-9]+)*-[0-9]+ IDs on word boundaries; resolve a ticket ID to its roadmap row and expand its named paths and symbols. Spec change plus eval gate.
title: context: learn the adopter's intent layout (spec roots, ID grammar, ticket-to-roadmap-row resolution)
